condition_other: spinal cord injury (T10 transection) with spasticity
readout_other: mechanical threshold (THMS); BBB score; H-reflex frequency-dependent depression; soleus EMG; KCC2 western blot and immunofluorescence
direction_notes: LIFU activated spinal neurocircuits (EMG recruitment) and after 4 weeks reduced spasticity measures and raised KCC2 expression versus LIFU- rats.

exposures.label: LIFU+ lumbar spinal cord stimulation after SCI

timing.protocol_description: Sine pulse LIFU to the spinal cord once a day, 20 min each time, starting 1 week after SCI for a total of 4 weeks.

source_quotes.n_subjects: group (n = 10), where all the rats received SCI and LIFU treatment, as shown in Figure 1A.
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: The LIFU parameters were as follows: sine pulse, frequency = 4 MHz, pulse repetition rate (PRF) = 0.8 kHz, radiation intensity (RI) = 0.65 MPa, and duty cycle (DC) = 50%.
source_quotes.exposures[0].unspecified_domain.pressure: The LIFU parameters were as follows: sine pulse, frequency = 4 MHz, pulse repetition rate (PRF) = 0.8 kHz, radiation intensity (RI) = 0.65 MPa, and duty cycle (DC) = 50%.
